attachments.name: medical_plan.txt
attachments.text:
EVENT MEDICAL PLAN
Westbrook City Race Half Marathon, Sunday 4 July 2027
Applicant: Westbrook Youth League
Issue: 1.3

1. Event summary
A half marathon race with 80 runners, starting at 09:30 in the Beacon Hill area of Port Halden. An ambulance from Halden Medical Transport is on site for the race; the paperwork is attached.

2. First aid cover
3 first aid posts will operate, at the start, at the finish and at the course midpoint, staffed by 8 qualified first aiders. Posts are placed so that no part of the course is more than 1.5 km from one. Two cycle responders move along the course with defibrillators.

3. Weather and hydration
Water is available every 2.5 km. The race director checks the forecast 48 hours and 2 hours before the start. Above 28 degrees C the start is brought forward or the course shortened, and above 32 degrees C the race is cancelled. In cold or wet conditions, foil blankets and a warm shelter are at the finish.

4. Transfer to hospital
The receiving hospital is Valley Regional Hospital, 16 km from the finish. The transfer route and the pick-up point at the rowing club have been walked with the first aid team. The hospital's emergency department has been told the date and the expected numbers.

5. Communications
Members of the team will have their mobile phones with them, and a list of contact numbers will be circulated in the week before the event. Coverage in the area is generally reported to be good.

Some background. Our committee has run this race for a number of years and takes the welfare of runners to heart. One of our longtime members is a retired paramedic who usually runs the race herself and is not on duty that day.

6. Clinical lead
Responsibility for welfare on the day rests with the race director, supported by the wider committee, all of whom take the wellbeing of participants extremely seriously.

attachments.name: race_plan.txt
attachments.text:
RACE PLAN
Westbrook City Race Half Marathon | Sunday 4 July 2027
Organiser: Westbrook Youth League
Race director: Maria Ostrowski
Reference: EV-29328

Overview
The Westbrook City Race Half Marathon is a half marathon race of 21 km for 80 entrants, based in the Beacon Hill area of Port Halden. The start is at 09:30 and the course closes at 13:00.

Course
The course stays entirely on the Gardens Loop and the Old Mill Trail, away from the highway, and no road is closed for the race. The finish is at the boathouse.

Course dimensions
Usable width on the Gardens Loop is 8 m and on the Old Mill Trail 12 m, with lawn or open paving beside the course for almost the whole distance. The finish area measures roughly 120 m by 60 m.

Support
Entrants collect numbers from the rowing club from one hour before the start. Timing is by chip, with mats at the start and finish. Results are posted on the Westbrook website the same day.
